negative_slope.description: A `float` that controls the slope for values lower than the threshold.
constraints: negative_slope must be one of float

max_value.description: A `float` that sets the saturation threshold (the largest value the function will return).
constraints: max_value must be one of float

threshold.description: A `float` giving the threshold value of the activation function below which values will be damped or set to zero.
constraints: threshold must be one of float

output.description: A tensor with the same shape and dtype as input `x`.
